clips.title: The story
paras: The Great Outdoors is an introductory quest that instructs aspiring adventurers in the fundamental arts of wilderness survival. Guided by the traveler Kaga, newcomers learn how to recuperate beside a basic campfire before advancing to learn tradeskills and craft specialized camp fixtures.

Every adventurer setting foot beyond the safety of civilization quickly discovers that raw courage is not enough to survive the frontier. The Great Outdoors introduces newcomers to the vital necessity of wilderness acclimation. Taught by the experienced traveler Kaga, this brief lesson reminds fledgling heroes that thriving in unexplored territories begins with knowing how to establish a camp and endure the open elements.

A simple campfire is often all that stands between an explorer and the exhaustion of the untamed wilderness. By taking a seat beside Kaga's hearth and gaining the Boosted Rest buff, adventurers discover the recuperative power of camp life. Once the fundamentals of wilderness rest are understood, Kaga urges travelers to visit nearby settlement artisans to learn tradeskills and master the crafting of professional camp fixtures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
